svg.title: sparse-what-shrinks
svg.desc: Two questions sort every route of chapters 05 to 08: does it shrink the records read or the records stored, and can the next query choose differently? Reads shrink and reversible: sparse reads (06: Quest, MoBA, NSA, DSA). Reads shrink and fixed: static patterns (05). Records shrink and irreversible: eviction (07), compression (08) and sliding-window layers (05). Records leave HBM but can return: offload (14). Llama-3-8B at 128K in BF16: reading 2,048 records keeps 16 GiB in HBM and moves 256 MiB per step; keeping 2,048 records stores and moves 256 MiB.
